about: Generated by sdks/testdata/generate_fixture.py, which imports and runs the real piishield.detectors.recognizers.scan_text against SAMPLE_TEXT (not hand-guessed values). Proves AC14 (SDK parity): both the Python and Node SDK unit tests load this fixture, call the SDK's response parser (Finding/ScanResult) on a response shaped like 'expected_api_response' below (the real shape of protection.schemas.ProtectTextOut with method 'skip' requested for every category, as the scan() method on both SDKs sends), and assert the parsed findings land at the same categories and spans listed in 'findings'. 'value_for_fixture_only' documents what each span contains for a human reading this file; it is not a field either SDK reads from the real API.
wire_format_assumption: POST /api/v1/detectors/scan with {project_id, text} returns {findings: [{category, start, end, confidence, checksum_valid, recognizer}], review_count}. Confirmed live against the running API on 2026-11-12. See sdks/python/README.md and sdks/node/README.md, 'Wire format' section.
